WatermarkAsset.title: WatermarkAsset
WatermarkAsset.description: Mapping of a 32-bit spatial luminance watermark integer and hexadecimal identifier to an authenticated https destination URL.

binary.description: 32-bit binary sequence string from MSB (b0) to LSB (b31)

targetUrl.description: Validated https:// destination URL for verified image redirection

title.description: Human-readable asset label for inventory identification

thumbnailDataUrl.description: Compact data URL visual preview for inventory display

delta.description: Luminance modulation safety margin delta in [1, 64]

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who registered the watermark

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the watermark asset was registered

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Delegated administrator Google email authorization record managed exclusively by the Super Admin (nahid.main.ai@gmail.com).

email.description: Normalized lowercase Google email address of the authorized administrator

displayName.description: Human-readable administrator name or role note

addedBy.description: Super Admin email who authorized this administrator

/watermarks/{watermarkId}.description: Publicly readable registry of verified 32-bit watermark identifiers mapped to official destination URLs; write access restricted to verified Super Admin and allowlisted administrators.

/admins/{adminEmail}.description: Trusted allowlist of delegated administrator Google email addresses managed exclusively by Super Admin nahid.main.ai@gmail.com.
